hierarchy.label: text-sm font-bold uppercase tracking-wider
hierarchy.notes: Ensure Hindi text always has adequate line height (leading-relaxed) to accommodate Devanagari matras (accents above and below the baseline). Never use tight leading on Hindi body text.

primary.description: Deep Navy. Used for main structural elements, typography, and conveying institutional trust.

accent.description: Warm Amber/Gold. Used for primary actions, floating action buttons (mic), and alerts.

background.description: Warm off-white paper tone to reflect the 'diary' motif and reduce eye strain compared to harsh clinical white.

rules: NO cream-and-terracotta, NO neon-on-black, NO purple gradients.
Never use pure transparent backgrounds over content.
Avoid glassmorphism entirely. Use Flat Solid surfaces for high contrast.

visual_enhancers.borders: Thick 2px borders (#E2E8F0) on form elements for extremely clear visual boundaries.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Hard drop shadows (e.g., `shadow-[0_4px_0_#0F172A]`) on buttons to make them feel deeply tactile and pressable, like physical kiosk buttons.
visual_enhancers.border_radius: Massive radii on buttons (`rounded-2xl` or `rounded-full`) for a friendly, approachable feel. Standard `rounded-xl` on cards.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle grain or noise can be used in the background `#FDFBF7` to subtly mimic a paper diary, but keep it low opacity (<3%) so it doesn't affect legibility.

component_patterns.buttons: Massive tap targets. Minimum height for primary buttons MUST be 64px (`h-16`). Include tactile active state (translate-y-1 + shadow reduction).
component_patterns.voice_mic: Huge central microphone button. When active, must show concentric, radiating pulse animations (Amber color).
component_patterns.urgent_toggle: Big switch or segmented control with distinct visual distinction. When 'तुरंत ज़रूरी' is active, pulse a soft red border around the container.
component_patterns.redundant_coding: Always pair Status Colors + Icon + Text. Example: [Check Icon] + Green Background + 'सुलझ गई'. Never use just a colored dot.
component_patterns.forms: One task per screen (Wizard). Input fields must be massive with 20px text size minimum for readability by elderly users.

grids.mobile_pwa: Single-column fixed height layout. `h-[100dvh]` with absolute positioned bottom action bar to prevent lost scrolling.
grids.desktop_dashboard: High-density CSS Grid (Bento style). Sidebar (`w-64`) + Main Content (`flex-1`). Main content uses `grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4` with tight `gap-4`.

sevadar_flow.layout: Large centered text 'आप कौन हैं?'. One massive dropdown/search for Sevadar Name. Huge 'आगे बढ़ें' (Next) button pinned to bottom.
Visual grid (2 columns) of 'Zones' or 'Gates' with clear icons. A big button for 'GPS लोकेशन लें' (Get GPS). Bottom pinned 'आगे बढ़ें' button.
Three huge blocks: (A) Central massive Mic button for Voice (B) 'फोटो खींचें' Camera button (C) Optional text area. Top-right big toggle for 'तुरंत ज़रूरी' (Urgent).
Summary card. Massive absolute bottom full-width button 'भेजें' (Send). Offline indicator above button: 'भेजने के लिए तैयार'.
Vertical list of cards. Each card has a thick left border matching its status color, prominent status pill (Icon+Text), time, and category icon.

office_dashboard.layout: Left sidebar (Filters: Status, Zone, Date, Search). Main area: Live feed of incidents (Table or Dense Card list) arranged newest first. Rows visually highlight Urgent reports with a red tint.
Split view or large slide-over. Top: Reporter info & Time. Middle: Media (Photo thumbnail, Waveform Audio Player). Bottom: Status dropdown, Office Notes textbox, 'Export PDF' button.

motion.general: Minimal and purposeful. Avoid decorative animations. Target audience is easily disoriented by excessive movement.
motion.feedback: Use micro-interactions for button presses (tactile click) and clear entrance transitions (e.g., sliding to the next wizard step).
motion.voice_recording: Crucial feedback loop. Mic button must visually throb/pulse significantly when recording.

accessibility.contrast: Exceed WCAG AA. Text over colored backgrounds must have >4.5:1 ratio. No light gray text on white.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements MUST have a high-contrast focus ring (`focus:ring-4 focus:ring-amber-500 focus:outline-none`).
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include `data-testid` attribute using kebab-case role-based names (e.g., `data-testid="sevadar-name-select"`, `data-testid="record-voice-button"`).

vintage_paper_texture.description: Subtle beige parchment paper texture, use as an absolute background layer with 3% opacity (`opacity-3` or `opacity-5`) and `mix-blend-multiply` to give the app a tactile diary feel.

instructions_to_main_agent: Design for extreme simplicity. The sevadar PWA should feel more like a physical remote control or kiosk than a modern SaaS app.
Implement the 'Redundant Coding' rule strictly: a status must use an Icon, a Color, and Hindi text combined.
Use 'Tiro Devanagari Hindi' for all main headings to create a trustworthy, authoritative 'book' feel.
Build the dashboard using standard Shadcn components but override borders/radii to match the tactical, flat, high-contrast aesthetic.
Hindi text (`Mukta` font) requires larger line-heights (`leading-relaxed`) compared to English to prevent matras (diacritics) from overlapping. Apply this globally.
When creating the PWA wizard, ensure the 'Next' / 'Send' buttons are physically pinned to the bottom of the viewport using `fixed bottom-0` or absolute positioning inside a 100vh flex container.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You MUST NOT apply universal transitions (e.g., `transition: all`). Add specific transitions for interactive elements.
DO NOT center align the app container. No `.App { text-align: center; }`.
Always use modern, purposeful button styles. In this project, use massive, tactile buttons with hard shadows.
NEVER use emojis as UI icons. Use lucide-react with strokeWidth 2.5 for thicker, highly visible iconography.
All interactive elements MUST have `data-testid` attributes.
Ensure glassmorphism is completely avoided in this specific project. Use solid background colors for all overlays and navs.
Do not use dark colors as gradients. Use solid colors.
